UKIT 3.4.42 RELEASE TRIAGE

Artifact: @ngockhoale/ukit 3.4.42 npm archive
SHA256: cb10ab03b9a535759c2efa52a897b99374a301281810199d2d93fdd332e8889a
Judgment: BENIGN. The supplied release-specific malware claim is not supported
by the inspected bytes. The LPM page was inaccessible to the web tool; its
reason and publication time were not independently established.

Identity and behavior:
The manifest declares an AI-workspace installer/updater and a ukit executable.
It declares no preinstall, install, postinstall or prepare lifecycle hook.
The archive has 754 regular members, no links, and no native executables. Its
non-text members are canvas-design fonts. Source review covered the CLI entry,
installation pipeline, gateway resolution/transport, process supervision,
flagged runtimes, benchmark, and the archive's network/encoding findings.

unic-decision.mjs resolves configured gateway credentials, sends bounded typed
model decisions through POST, checks sensitive input, and parses tool_calls as
data. Its circuit-state write is independent of the response body. Important
configuration risk: its shared-token fallback can send an ANTHROPIC_API_KEY or
ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN to the default UNIC endpoint without verifying that the
credential belongs to that provider. This is explicitly documented routing,
not evidence of a concealed credential-stealing payload.
route-task.mjs reads local indices/memory, produces routing advice and launches
local helpers. user:user is a memory-record identifier, not a login pair.
stop-coordinator.mjs merges local completion/watchdog/handoff results, uses
locks and deadlines, launches the local ledger and git, and reaps its children.
watchdogRuntime.evaluateStopWatchdog is not a CDP Runtime.evaluate token.
memory-baseline.mjs measures tests, npm pack and memory operations against
fixture copies in temporary directories, then writes JSON/Markdown reports.
The router's decoded strings are Unicode normalization and Vietnamese routing
patterns, not hidden commands. binwalk was unavailable; source-level review
and tar member/byte inspection were applicable to this source distribution.

Rule corrections and scope:
CDP uses full token boundaries and describes a method token, not dispatch.
Bare api-key mappings require object-map punctuation, excluding ternaries.
user:user requires a standalone credential-list line, excluding object IDs.
VS Code settings requires an actual VS Code path or joined Code/User path.
Repeated block/allow fixture rules require array-valued property lines.
HTTP-read/file-write co-occurrence now additionally requires the file data
argument to originate in a text/arrayBuffer/buffer call, allowing a Buffer.from
conversion through argument zero. The description does
not claim that the reader belongs to the same HTTP request elsewhere.
Four neutral observations moved from objectives: budget wording to UI keywords,
watchdog kill command to process termination, quoted agent-prefixed paths to
path references, and MEMORY.md append syntax to file append. Attack mappings
were removed from those observations. The agent-path matcher also excludes
agent_id/agent_type prose. Watchdog platform scope was retained.
Exact consumers were updated. Ancestor selectors retain their subject scope;
they do not acquire neutral observations moved outside attacker-objective
branches. The duplicate synchronous-launch umbrella was removed from the shell
namespace. Its secret-search consumer uses the canonical child-process launch
composite, intentionally admitting asynchronous launches with the same required
inventory and credential context instead of treating all launches as shells.
No product/version allowlist was introduced.

Verification:
Seven committed positive/near-miss controls pass via check.py. A full Code/User
settings path is retained alongside joined components, preserving the malicious
VSIX terminal-config fixture. The renamed fetch/write expectation was updated;
Salt's benign score floor drops by one after removing false VS Code attribution. Atomscan rescanned
the archive and all four highlighted files with automatic updates and reference
fetching disabled. All five have zero hostile and zero suspicious findings.
Archive notable findings: 768 before, 760 after. Member notable findings after:
unic-decision 69; route-task 66; stop-coordinator 63; memory-baseline 59.
Final make validate is required after the judgment markers and commit.
